Some courses are mutually exclusive, like 'Statistics for Biology' and 'Statistics for Business'. The 'Robotics Lab' course is an optional elective with a hard enrollment cap of 20 students.     abstract base class Course

        operations

            seminar : boolean

            unregister(course: Course)

        constraints

    class Mathematics extends Course

        constraints

    class DissertationProposalReviewPassed

    class BachelorStudent extends Student
        attributes
            course_type : CourseType
            core_course : Course

        operations

                    core_course := course

            seminar_course : Course

        operations
            register(course: Course)
                if course_type.seminar and course.credit_hours == 3
                    seminar_course := course

end UniversityCourseRegistrationSystem
